t: This is Fulham War Memorial, a Grade II listed monument in Vicarage Garden, off Fulham High Street. It was made by Alfred Turner, an English sculptor known for several large public monuments. His work includes statues of Queen Victoria, pieces in Fishmongers' Hall in London, and a number of other war memorials, both in the British Isles and abroad. This one is his contribution to Fulham, standing in a quiet garden beside the busy high street.
